{{Quote|C'mon, grubber, you've had enough. Food's expensive y'know!|[[Alph (guard)|Alph]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 69">[[Star Wars (1977) 69|''Star Wars'' (1977) 69]]</ref>}}
This '''Mandalorian''' was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[City of Bone]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. During a lunch break, this slave began to complain about the poor quality of the food being served. While eating out of a trough, he claimed that he couldn't eat the food because something in it was still alive. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] slaver, [[Alph (guard)|Alph]], who was overseeing the slaves eat, decided to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] the slave for his complaint, and he forced the Mandalorian's face into the muck. As the Mandalorian struggled to breathe, another Imperial guard reminded Alph that dead slaves increased overhead. Alph reluctantly let the slave take a breath, and jeeringly called him a "[[grubber]]" for eating too much.

During the [[Battle of the City of Bone|revolt]] in the city, and the destruction of the power source to the slaves [[Energy cuffs|energy links]], the slave was freed.
